name: DyPOS
description: Global multi-tenant smart POS and cashier platform for commercial operations, with offline-first execution, intelligent synchronization, and service-based free credits. Proprietary commercial software.
comment: The root manifest orchestrates the workspaces: it holds no runtime code of
its own. dompurify and baseline-browser-mapping were declared here while
nothing at the root imported them (POS declares its own copies), and
playwright is a test-only tool used by the e2e specs — a dependency, so
every production install of the root pulled a browser binary it never used.
